title: Newton's Laws of Motion
summary: The three foundational laws that describe motion and forces.
subject: Physics

sections.heading: First Law - Inertia
sections.body: An object stays at rest, or in uniform motion, unless acted on by a net external force.

sections.heading: Second Law - F = ma
sections.body: Acceleration is proportional to net force and inversely proportional to mass: F = m x a.

sections.heading: Third Law - Action & Reaction
sections.body: For every action there is an equal and opposite reaction.

keyTerms.definition: Vector sum of all forces on an object.
